reviews.title: Lian li build
reviews.comment: Works awesome under pressure. Playing cod furniture it runs close to 50c. Running it on amd ryzen 7 9800x3d. Motherboard is rog strix 870a. The lian li software to adjust colors and motions is easy to use and easy to connect mutiple fans together. Overall so far so good. Looks good as well. The cooling tubes rotate to makes installing easy. The fan speed will kick up on demand or you can go into the software and manually adjust it to your liking. The lcd screen is fully customizable and you can upload your own images or gifs. It has a range of presets as well. Highly recommend as it looks amazing and preforms as well.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.title: Looks great, works great. What more need be said?
reviews.comment: This AIO works great. I replaced the fans with the Lian Li Wireless TL UNI fans and everything is going great. It's not loud, it was packaged well, and everything is all systems go.
reviews.author: Vernon McKee

reviews.title: Sick CPU cooler
reviews.comment: Works perfectly. Haven’t had any issues. Lighting is amazing and totally customizable. LCD screen is clear and quality. I love it!
reviews.author: Emarie

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1k6u-Fy6aL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61LfjIm4eoL._SY256.jpg So this AIO is absolutely amazing. I love the software and how customizable it is not to mention it keeps my CPU nice and cool even when playing some pretty intensive games like COD. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because the actual install was a nightmare. The instructions are not super clear and I relied heavily on YouTube to get it done. Other than that definitely worth the money for functionality and aesthetics!
